title: Celtics Green or Mean — AI Fan Cam
description: Fans scan a QR code, snap a selfie, and pick Green (Hype) or Mean (Roast). Claude Vision scores each photo for energy, Celtics spirit, and originality, then generates playful PA-announcer roast lines. An operator dashboard queues the best fans for the jumbotron. Presentation: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1RMdtYTSITz0C0YzBoQAEVWxwoYdjaHzV1Q_2e8DRmfA
